A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same DEFAME research work. All 35 pages in each version, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–O, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, human evaluations and appendix analyses, including justification-generation results in Table 8.

after.justification: v4 retains these original benchmark experiments, ablations, human evaluations and appendix results.

M1.justification: The six-stage DEFAME pipeline, four tools, iterative verdict procedure and INFACT adaptation remain unchanged, including their descriptions in Appendices E–F.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate AVERITEC, MOCHEG, VERITE and CLAIMREVIEW2024+, retaining the same task coverage, challenge evaluation and human-study scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains CFR, DEBERTA, LVLM4FV, METASUM, CHASMA, AITR and both GPT-4o baselines. Comparator membership in the challenge and appendix justification comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated dataset subsets, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, retrieval limits and human-study design are unchanged. No protocol revision accompanies the Table 2 score updates.

E4.justification: Table 4's tool and stage ablations are identical. Confusion analyses, annotation-error investigations, temporal-validity discussion, justification analyses and qualitative success/failure cases are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over three runs in Table 3. Appendix L retains the same human-study sample information and Mann–Whitney U test; no uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 2 changes GPT-4o-backed DEFAME accuracy from 59.5 to 59.2 on MOCHEG and from 84.5 to 83.9 on VERITE. These now match the values already reported in Section 5.3 and Tables 3–4 in both versions. All other numerical and qualitative results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix F's formal representation of DEFAME and Appendix J's derivation equating micro-F1 with accuracy remain identical. No definitions, assumptions or proofs are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about multimodal evidence retrieval, zero-shot generality, state-of-the-art performance and temporal generalization on CLAIMREVIEW2024+.

C2.justification: Interpretations of retrieval benefits, tool contributions and failure modes are unchanged. Limitations concerning evidence credibility, scraping stability, hallucinations, temporal ground truth and justification metrics are also retained.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware and cost disclosures, excluded domains, prompt templates, and code/data availability statements and URLs are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the prior-system overview in Table 1, citations and bibliography are unchanged, as is DEFAME's positioning relative to earlier research.

P1.justification: v4 adds running paper-title headers and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Running title headers are added on pages 2–35. Figures, table structures, captions and placements remain unchanged throughout the main paper and appendices.

improvement.justification: v4 aligns the two Table 2 entries with Section 5.3 and Tables 3–4, removing unexplained cross-table discrepancies present in v3. This modestly improves reporting consistency; the scientific methods, evidence base and conclusions remain unchanged.
